title: Machine learning screens melatonin-related candidate biomarker genes in ischemic stroke
summary: Using GEO transcriptome data, SVM-RFE, random forest and LASSO screened melatonin-related candidate genes, and four key genes (ADM, PTGS2, MMP9, VCAN) were proposed as stroke biomarkers. An XGBoost model on eight genes reached an AUC of 0.806 (95% CI 0.778-0.833), with validation GEO datasets GSE58294 and GSE174574. qPCR in a rat ischemic stroke model found all four genes upregulated. Public microarray data and a rat model only; no human clinical cohort and a moderate AUC.
ai_technology: SVM-RFE, random forest and LASSO for candidate gene selection; XGBoost diagnostic model on 8 genes

evidence.tested: Four genes in validation GEO datasets and by qPCR in blood of a rat ischemic stroke model.
evidence.unknown: Whether the genes work as clinical biomarkers in humans; no human cohort was tested.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning selectors chose candidate genes and an XGBoost model assessed their diagnostic value.
